audit.report: The month-end close job blocked checkout, causing 28 of 60 checkout attempts to time out over 15 seconds and success to fall to 27% over 30 seconds against a 95% SLO. The root blocker was pid 121326, an idle-in-transaction batch_replayable_month_end_close job open for 4 seconds, holding locks that 12 sessions were waiting on. With $18,400 per minute of revenue at risk and a 60-second degradation tolerance, waiting for the close to finish would have cost about $808,700. Both guardians agreed the termination decision belonged to finance-ops under active change window CHG-4410, so the action was escalated rather than executed. Checkout was not recovered by the end of the negotiation.
